partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Dual-target non-SemMed genetic consensus
results.hypothesis: A compact dual-target mechanism is more credible when both causal gene-disease paths have primary support outside SemMedDB.
results.body: R095 with ontology-specific disease and non-SemMed genetic support for both targets
results.mechanism_rationale: Two independently supported causal genes converge in a compact process under directional drug inhibition, but disease-driving activity direction is absent.
results.trapi_notes: The biological paths are TRAPI-expressible; source provenance, two-target identity, compactness, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[evidence1:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[evidence2:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene2)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND evidence1._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND evidence2._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Cross-agent dual-target provenance topology
results.hypothesis: A dual-target module is more credible when its binding evidence spans manual and automated agents in addition to independent genetics.
results.body: R141 with both manual-agent and automated-agent binding evidence somewhere across the two targets
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule requires independent genetic evidence and heterogeneous molecular evidence across a nonlinear target module, reducing single-pipeline artifacts.
results.trapi_notes: The biological paths are TRAPI-expressible; agent-type existence, source provenance, cardinality, compactness, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[evidence1:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[evidence2:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene2)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND evidence1._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND evidence2._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[manual:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(manual_gene)
    WHERE manual_gene IN [gene1, gene2]
      AND manual.agent_type = 'manual_agent'
  }
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[automated:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
          (automated_gene)
    WHERE automated_gene IN [gene1, gene2]
      AND automated.agent_type = 'automated_agent'
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Per-target manual and automated provenance consensus
results.hypothesis: The strongest dual-target provenance topology requires each causal target independently to have both manual and automated binding evidence.
results.body: R141 with manual-agent and automated-agent binding evidence for each target separately
results.mechanism_rationale: Every molecular and genetic arm of the two-target module has independent provenance classes, yielding a highly corroborated mechanism despite missing disease-direction evidence.
results.trapi_notes: The biological paths are TRAPI-expressible; four agent-type existence checks, provenance, cardinality, compactness, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[evidence1:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[evidence2:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene2)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND evidence1._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND evidence2._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[manual1:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1)
    WHERE manual1.agent_type = 'manual_agent'
  }
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[automated1:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1)
    WHERE automated1.agent_type = 'automated_agent'
  }
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[manual2:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2)
    WHERE manual2.agent_type = 'manual_agent'
  }
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[automated2:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2)
    WHERE automated2.agent_type = 'automated_agent'
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
